concept.title: A baby group to go to today
concept.shortdesc: As a parent at home with a young baby, I need to find a baby group nearby that is running today, so that I can get out of the house and meet other parents.

conbody.note: Draft need (N-001). The needs catalogue is a model's draft from persona use cases and has not been agreed with stakeholders; the category links are proposals and are not confirmed.

section.title: The need
section.p: Situation: Isolated and tired at home with a baby of a few months, often looking on a phone while feeding; wants somewhere to go the same day.
A good result: A short list of groups running today within easy reach, each with time, cost, whether to book and the age range.
How much it matters: Convenience: a miss is an inconvenience, so the bar is lower.

ul.li: I need to get out of the house with my 4-month-old. Are there any baby groups near me in Handsworth today?
